name: Valle de Manzanedo (Spain)
description: A white cross throughout with the cantons alternately blue and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valle de Manzanedo (an apple tree on white within a chequy bordure).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 9 January 1996 (Boletín Oficial del Estado no. 33 of 7 February 1996); the flag is described as of proportion 2:3, with a white cross, the cantons alternately blue and yellow, and the municipal arms in its colours over all at the centre.

features.role: Valle de Manzanedo arms — apple tree within a chequy bordure
